question: In a code language, ‘CANDLE’ is written as ‘3-1-14-4-12-5’ and ‘DARK’ is written as ‘4-1-18-11’. How will ‘LIGHT’ be written in that language?
solution: The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] The logic followed here is, according to the position of the English alphabet series.
